description: Glitch-free reactive state for TypeScript applications: boxes, computed values, keyed collections, updates, and watchers, with Effect Schema boxes and models for checked data and React hooks. Not Pinia, Vue's store.
rules: Pinna is not Pinia: it shares no API with Vue's store.
Import from @frondruntime/pinna (no schema) or @frondruntime/pinna-effect (adds Box.schema and Model.Schema), never both in one file: each exports its own Box.
A name that starts with $ is an observable: a box, a computed value, an atom, or a collection. Everything else is plain readonly data.
Read with the read a place hands out (Computed.make, Realm.watch, Realm.autorun, Realm.update, useSelect); never keep a read past its place.
Write only inside Realm.update(realm, (read, write) => ...): write($box, value), write.modify for drafts, write.upsert and write.remove for collections.
A Box.schema or Model.boxField checks every write against its schema; a Box.make checks nothing.
A derived value is a $ property in the class body: readonly $total = Computed.make(this.realm, (read) => ...).
